other_conditions: Applicant must be listed in the Socio-Economic Caste Census (SECC) database.
Applicant must be interested in establishing a sheep‑rearing unit for self‑employment.
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of up to ₹63,000 (90% of the total ₹70,000) is provided to establish a sheep‑rearing unit of 10 female and 1 male sheep, disbursed via DBT within 1‑2 months.
